title: How noisy is 'too noisy'
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Should noise limits be based on measured decibels or on how disturbing a sound feels?
Which everyday noises bother you even when they are not very loud?
Who should have priority when neighbours disagree about acceptable noise?
Should cities be quieter at night even if that limits nightlife and business?
Would you pay more to live in a much quieter neighbourhood?
